readme:
# Praca.gov.pl Scraper: Poland Central Job Offers Database (CBOP)

Extract job listings from **praca.gov.pl** — Poland's **Central Job Offers Database** (Centralna Baza Ofert Pracy, CBOP), operated by the **Ministry of Family and Social Policy** (Ministerstwo Rodziny i Polityki Spolecznej).

CBOP is the **official national employment portal** of Poland. It aggregates vacancies from all 340 Powiatowy Urzad Pracy (PUP) local employment offices across all 16 Polish voivodeships, plus EU/EURES cross-border listings. As a government database, all listings are verified by public employment offices.

## What you get

Each record includes:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` | Job title (stanowisko) |
| `company_name` | Employer name |
| `company_nip` | Polish VAT/tax ID (NIP) of employer |
| `company_website` | Employer website (when disclosed) |
| `location` | City / gmina |
| `region` / `voivodeship` | One of 16 Polish voivodeships |
| `address_full` | Full address e.g. `14-260 Fijewo 55, powiat: iławski, woj: warmińsko-mazurskie` |
| `postal_code` | Postal code e.g. `14-260` |
| `street_address` | Street and number e.g. `Fijewo 55` |
| `powiat` | County/district (powiat) e.g. `iławski` |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | GPS coordinates of workplace |
| `pup` | Powiatowy Urzad Pracy (local office) |
| `pup_email` | PUP contact email |
| `job_number` | CBOP reference e.g. `StPr/26/0659` |
| `job_scope` | `KRAJOWY` / `LOKALNY` / `UE` / `POZA-UE` |
| `positions_open` | Number of open positions |
| `positions_for_disabled` | Positions reserved for people with disabilities |
| `disabled_friendly` | Offer open to people with disabilities |
| `requires_registration` | Requires employment office registration |
| `pfron_funded` | PFRON-subsidised employment |
| `employment_type` | `permanent`, `fixed-term`, `commission-contract`, `task-contract`, `internship` ... |
| `work_schedule` | e.g. `full-time / jedna zmiana / 40h/week` |
| `hours_per_week` | Weekly hours (liczbaGodzinWTygodniu) |
| `immediate_hire` | Whether employer hires immediately |
| `accommodation_provided` | Accommodation included |
| `meals_provided` | Meals included |
| `start_date` | Contract start date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `salary_min` / `salary_max` | Numeric salary bounds |
| `salary_currency` | Always `PLN` |
| `salary_period` | Always `month` |
| `salary_text` | Raw salary text e.g. `od 6 000 PLN` |
| `salary_note` | Additional salary note e.g. `w zależności od doświadczenia` |
| `contact_person` | Contact person name (Osoba do kontaktu) |
| `contact_emails` | Employer contact emails |
| `contact_phones` | Employer phone numbers |
| `application_method` | How to apply (e.g. `bezpośrednio do pracodawcy`) |
| `required_documents` | Documents required for application |
| `education_required` | Required education levels (list) |
| `licenses_required` | Required licences and permits (list) |
| `languages_required` | Required languages (list) |
| `experience_required` | Required experience (free text) |
| `occupation` | Polish occupational classification name |
| `description` | Duties and requirements (500-char snippet) |
| `description_full` | Full plain-text duties + requirements |
| `valid_until` | Offer expiry date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `posted_at_datetime` | ISO timestamp of posting |

## Input

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["programista", "kierowca", "ksiegowy"],
  "location": "Warszawa",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "includeJobDetails": true
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | string[] | required | Polish keywords: `programista`, `pielegniarka`, `kierowca`, `spawacz` |
| `location` | string | | City or voivodeship: `Warszawa`, `Krakow`, `mazowieckie` |
| `maxResults` | integer | 100 | Global cap across all queries |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | 100 | Cap per keyword |
| `includeJobDetails` | boolean | true | Fetch full CBOP detail: address, contact person, NIP, requirements, start date |
| `includeCompanyDetails` | boolean | false | Also extract company website |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | 5 | Concurrent detail requests (1-20) |

## Polish employment types

The CBOP uses these Polish contract types, mapped to English:

| Polish | English (this scraper) |
|---|---|
| Umowa o prace na czas nieokreslony | `permanent` |
| Umowa o prace na czas okreslony | `fixed-term` |
| Umowa o prace na okres probny | `probationary` |
| Umowa o prace | `employment-contract` |
| Umowa zlecenie | `commission-contract` |
| Umowa o dzielo | `task-contract` |
| Staz | `internship` |
| Praktyka | `traineeship` |

## 16 Polish voivodeships covered

Mazowieckie, Slaskie, Malopolskie, Wielkopolskie, Dolnoslaskie, Lodzkie, Lubelskie, Podkarpackie, Pomorskie, Kujawsko-Pomorskie, Zachodniopomorskie, Warminsko-Mazurskie, Podlaskie, Swietokrzyskie, Lubuskie, Opolskie.

## Job scope flags

- `KRAJOWY` - national listing (visible across Poland)
- `LOKALNY` - local listing (specific PUP jurisdiction)
- `UE` - EU/EURES cross-border listing
- `POZA-UE` - non-EU work authorization required

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing (no subscription):

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Actor start | $0.001 |
| SERP result (no detail) | $0.003 per job |
| Job detail result | $0.005 per job |

Example: 1,000 jobs with full details = ~$5.00

## Data freshness

CBOP listings are published by PUP offices in real time. The portal holds 40,000+ active listings at any given time. Run daily or weekly to capture new postings.
